rules_text:
Rules summary Game Play Make pairs by matching a card from your hand with a card from the common card area by their numbers or color. If you can't or don't want to make a pair, you draw two cards then discard one to the common card area. You get to take a second turn if you match a pair of 3s. Scoring You score the numbers on the pair of cards. If you match both color AND number, you get double the points. The first player who made their fourth pair take the 5/15 token with the 5 side up. If a player possesses the 5/15 token when they made their fifth pair, they get to flip it to the 15 sides. These scores are added to their total. Round and Game End Round ends when a player made their fifth pair. If that player is holding the 5/15 token when the fifth pair is made, it is flipped to the 15pt side and then all other players get one last turn. If the player making a fifth pair does not have the 5/15 token, it is stolen from the player who does and left on the 5 point side. The round then ends immediately. All players add points from made pairs (same number and color count as double points) and the 5/15 token if owned. All players will draw back up to two cards. If no player is at 200 points, the next round begins. Game ends when one or more players have more than 200 points at the end of a round. The player with the highest points is the winner.

[Rating: 9/10] 5Pairs is a quick and surprisingly tactical card game. It’s easy to learn and a lot of fun, but there’s more strategy involved than you might expect. Keeping track of which cards have already been played can really pay off, and sometimes it’s even worth deliberately taking cards to set up the perfect final move.  For us, 5Pairs works best with 3–4 players – fast, clever and great fun!

[Rating: 10/10] An interesting little game that may seem simple at first, but quickly becomes surprisingly thinky. You really have to plan your moves carefully and play strategically. I've played it at several conventions in Croatia and it has always led to plenty of laughs and a genuinely fun experience! It has become one of the most-played small games in my gaming group. On top of that, the retro artwork is absolutely charming and the game looks fantastic on the table. I hope this 10/10 rating encourages more people to give it a chance.
